decision: Lowest geometric mean repeated-sequence ratio to Torch across four selection cases and two process rounds; opt-in because all aggregate ratios exceed Torch.
criterion: Equal weight for every case/process; final 40 of 50 requests, no E3 or held-out data.
limitations: Two selection rounds are exploratory, not a strong uncertainty estimate.
Admission uses source bytes; a large indexed source with a small output can still be admitted.
Every new live parameter revision must independently earn reuse; fallback speedups are not native kernel speedups.
row_policy=cpu controls typed rows; layout-only prepared groups still use device layout.
